description: This file defines the Minify_ImportProcessor class, which processes CSS/JS files to inline @import directives and fix relative URIs, primarily used for minification and optimization.

classes.name: Minify_ImportProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing CSS/JS files to inline @import statements and fix relative URLs for minification purposes.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Static method to process a file, initialize the class, and get its content with inlined imports.

methods.name: _getContent
methods.description: Private method to read a file, process @import directives, and fix URLs if CSS.

methods.name: _importCB
methods.description: Callback for processing @import directives, fetching imported content.

methods.name: _urlCB
methods.description: Callback for fixing relative URLs within CSS content.
